title: Escritoir

inlines.v: ESCRITO'IR, noun [Latin scribo; Eng. to scrape.] A box with instruments and conveniences for writing; sometimes, a desk or chest of drawers with an apartment for the instruments of writing. It is often pronounced scrutoir.
